registration: WoodenDummyRotationAssets.Load bakes cell pivots and panel/contact landmarks. Full-body silhouettes remain padded and share one texture.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production Unity 2D game sprite animation atlas, 8 full-body turntable frames of ONE wooden martial arts training dummy.
Input image 1 (WoodenDummyAtlas.png): exact reference for timber grain, golden brown wood, dark pixel edges, cream rope, three asymmetric cylindrical striking pegs and wooden brace base.
Input image 2 (front-final.png): reference for how the assembled dummy looks in the existing Korean dojo game. Ignore ALL background, UI, people/hands and text.
Primary request: create a coherent eight-direction FULL BODY rotation sprite sheet. The broad round wooden head with its square recessed front display, the narrower long rope-bound column, all three side pegs, and the lower braced stand MUST turn together around ONE vertical axis. Preserve this existing design and painterly pixel-art texture, not a robot, not a human.
Composition: 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal 512x768 cells, total 2048x1536 pixels. ONE complete dummy centered on each cell, identical height, same vertical pivot, top at cell y=25 and foot at y=740. Fixed orthographic camera slightly above eye level, same light upper left. Generous transparent margins. No ground shadow. All eight silhouettes fully inside their own cell.
Frame order left to right top row then bottom row: front 0 degrees; front three-quarter 45 degrees (front display travels to viewer RIGHT); right edge-on 90 degrees (display invisible); back three-quarter 135; full back 180; opposite back three-quarter 225; opposite edge-on 270; opposite front three-quarter 315 (display on viewer LEFT).
Keep same round head diameter and column length through all frames. Give the body a substantial solid column and clearly visible protruding strike pegs BELOW the head so the hands can hit them. At the front view: upper peg points right just below head, middle peg points left a bit lower, third peg points right lower still. The peg tips shorten, overlap and switch depth as the WHOLE rigid object rotates. Preserve consistent peg elevations, rope bands and wood knots. Braced wooden feet also rotate with body; never leave a static front body under a rotating head.
Head takes roughly upper 36 percent of object height, long narrower body with the 3 pegs and braced feet takes lower 64 percent. Square blank recessed wooden display centered on FRONT of round head, no album art or lettering. Visible only in frame 0 and the two front three-quarter frames; it foreshortens into the cylinder in 45/315. Side/back frames show solid timber, never a second front panel. Exact same object each cell, no visual redesigns.
Style: match existing warm amber wood, painted pixel texture, crisp dark brown pixel outlines and pale twisted rope; retain grain detail. Transparent background (actual alpha), NO checkerboard pixels, NO brown/black background, NO labels, NO numbers, NO letters, NO arrows, NO motion streaks, NO extra objects.
